title: BaxxeyCraft
description: BaxxeyCraft is a survival economy SMP where the goal is simple: build wealth, climb the ranks, and dominate the leaderboards. Every hour of farming, every mob grind, and every smart trade brings you closer to the top.
body: A survival economy SMP where you build wealth, climb ranks, and compete for the top spot on the leaderboards, with free progression, a sell multiplier system, proximity chat, player warps, auction house, crates, jobs, and full Bedrock crossplay support.
